summary: The root ألم (Alm) signifies experiencing pain or aching. It describes a state of suffering, whether of a person or a body part like the belly or head.
lane: 1 أَلِمَ ذ , aor. اَلَمَ , inf. n. أَلَمٌ , It, (as, for instance, the belly, T, S, or the head, Msb,) or he, (a man, T, S, Msb,) was in pain; had, or suffered, pain; ached. (T, S, M, Msb, K.) أَلِمَ بَطْنَهُ [ He was in pain, or had pain, in his belly ] (M) and أَلِمْتَ بَطْنَكَ [ thou wast in pain, or hadst pain, in thy belly ] (T, S) or رَأْسَكَ [ in thy head ] (Msb) are like سَفِهَ رَأْيَهُ (M) and رَشِدْتَ أَمْرَكَ (S, T) and وَجِعْتَ رَأْسَكَ ; (Msb;) the noun being in the accus. case accord. to Ks as an explicative, though explicatives are [by rule] indeterminate, as in قَرِرْتُ بِهِ عَيْنًا and ضَقْتُ بِهِ ذَرْعًا ; (T;) the regular form being [ أَلِمَ بَطْنُهُ and] أَلِمَ بَطْنُكَ , (T, S,) as the verb is intrans. (T.)

headwords.gloss: He was; became, pained; he expressed pain, grief

parts.t: the conduct or the like of
such a one; complained of such a one
on account of the hardness of the time

headwords.def: تألّم He was, or became, pained: (M, * Msb, K: *) or he expressed pain, grief, or sorrow; lamented; complained; made lamentation or complaint; moaned; syn. تَوَجَّعَ , (T, S,) and شَكَى . (T.) You say, تَأَلَّمَ فُلَانٌ مِنْ فُلَانٍ [ Such a one expressed pain, &c., on account of the conduct or the like of such a one; complained of such a one ]: (T:) and لِأَزْمَةِ الزَّمَانِ [ on account of the hardness of the time ]. (TA in art. ازم .)

headwords.gloss: Pain; ache; I do not find pain nor ache; I will assuredly bring upon thee

I do not find pain nor ache;
: so says AZ: and IAar says,

I will assuredly bring upon thee

headwords.def: أَلَمٌ Pain; ache; (T, S, M, K;) as also : (T, M, K:) pl. (of the former, T, M) آلَامٌ . (T, M, K.) You say, مَا أَجِدُ وَلَا أَلَمًا I do not find pain nor ache; i. e. وَجَعًا : so says AZ: and IAar says, أَيْلَمَةً وَلَا as meaning the same. (T.) And the Arabs say, لَأُبِيتَنَّكَ عَلَى , meaning I will assuredly bring upon thee [lit. make thee to pass the night in ] distress, or difficulty. (Sh.)

headwords.gloss: Being in pain; having; suffering, pain; aching
headwords.def: أَلِمٌ Being in pain; having, or suffering, pain; aching. (M, K.)
إِلَامَ ألام ألم أم الأم الام آلام a contraction of إلَى مَا : see إِلَى , last sentence.

headwords.gloss: Causing pain; aching; painful; i. q

parts.t: : (S:) so when applied to punishment [or torment or torture]: (T, Msb:) or, thus applied,

headwords.def: أَلِيمٌ Causing pain or aching; painful; (S, K;) i. q. ; (T, M, Msb;) like سَمِيعٌ as syn. with مُسْمِعٌ : (S:) so when applied to punishment [or torment or torture]: (T, Msb:) or, thus applied, painful, or causing pain or aching, in the utmost degree. (M, K.)
أَلُومَةٌ Lowness, ignobleness, baseness, vileness, or meanness. (O, K.)

headwords.gloss: A sound; voice; I heard not any sound

parts.t: , in three places. Accord. to IAar, (T,)

headwords.def: أَيْلَمَةٌ : see أَلَمٌ , in three places. Accord. to IAar, (T,) A sound, or voice. (T, K.) You say, مَا سَمِعْتُ لَهُ أَيْلَمَةٌ I heard not any sound, or voice, of, or belonging to, him, or it. (IAar, T.) Accord. to AA, (T,) Motion. (T, K.)
